title: Venue-share flows and the euro premium (3 trials)

trials.A OKX volume share XS: 57 coins: OKX perp quote volume / (OKX + Binance perp quote volume), daily; score = log(7-day mean share / 90-day mean share); long the third whose OKX share rose most, short the third whose share fell most; inverse-vol legs, 3 tranches
trials.B Coinbase volume share XS: 18 coins with Coinbase USD data (BTC/ETH incl.): Coinbase USD volume x price / Binance perp quote volume, daily; same score and construction as A (rising US share -> long)
trials.C euro premium hourly spike: BTC: premium = BTCEUR / (EURUSDT x BTCUSDT perp) - 1 on Binance hourly closes; z vs 720 h (lagged) > 3 -> long BTC and ETH perps 0.25 each for 4 h, < -3 -> short

bars: DEV (2020-22 or from the data start) > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, |corr v8.6| <= 0.2, |corr premium-spike sleeve| <= 0.5
